messages:
Nina (PM): Quick thread: pricing page experiment + micro-calculator + webinar routing. Launch goal: Mon 9am PT. Need owners and a clean checklist.
Jon (Growth): I'll lead the launch post and the benchmark headline. Marta please drop P50/P95 latency and per-1k-token cost by EOD.
Rhea (Content): I'll take FAQ updates and the webinar description. Tone: pragmatic, metrics-first. Draft by Fri noon.
Tao (Design): New tier badges and inline calculator UI in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/pricing-experiment-ui-2026. Will export assets Thu.
Marta (Data): Uploaded summary CSV to /drive/pricing/experiments_2026.csv. Top-line: quantized variants change median cost by ~35%. Will include chart image.
Ivy (Ops): Routing rec: webinar registrants -> mktg nurture list; form fills with expected_commit >= 3000 -> sales webhook. Will provide Zap mapping.
Nina (PM): We should A/B test tier labels. Variant A: Core / Scale / Enterprise. Variant B: Flux / Prime / Vault. Jon set 20% to B.
Jon (Growth): Done. I'll add analytics tags: pricing_tier_variant = A/B and calc_used = true/false.
Rhea (Content): New FAQ items I'm adding: "How are tokens measured?", "When to pick Dedicated vs Hosted", "What savings come from caching?" Short answers + link to docs.
Tao (Design): Embed snippet for the micro-calculator (dev):
```
<!-- pricing micro-calc -->
<iframe src="https://app.redwood.example/embed/calc?variant=B" width="440" height="300" title="Pricing calculator"></iframe>
```
Jon (Growth): Need AMP-compatible fallback. @frontend please advise.
Marta (Data): For the benchmark blurb: P50 latency 45ms (hosted), 28ms (dedicated), cost per 1k tokens range $0.20-$0.75 depending on model/quantization. Sharing PNG chart.
Ivy (Ops): HubSpot list name: pricing-experiment-registrants. Field mapping: expected_commit -> lead_score, calc_result -> property.
Nina (PM): Owners: Jon = launch post + A/B; Rhea = FAQ + webinar copy; Tao = visuals + embed; Marta = numbers + chart; Ivy = routing + HubSpot. Everyone confirm?
All: Confirmed.
Jon (Growth): I'll draft the benchmark narrative: 3 bullets + CTA to webinar; will include a small comparison table.
Rhea (Content): Pushing doc: https://docs.google.com/pricing-experiment-faq  comments open :eyes:
Nina (PM): Final freeze Thurs 4pm. After that we flip the publish switch Mon 9am PT. Thanks team :rocket:
bot-calendar: Provisional event created "Pricing experiments: live demo & Q&A" Mon 10:00 PT  invites sent.
